Maintain and enhance technical skills and expertise in Cyber security to support global business development.  Improve and develop tools and methods to appropriately capture and quantity the diverse set of 1st and 3rd party cyber risks. Collaborate closely with the ARC Cyber Team and Underwriting in improving and promoting the Cyber product, using all the available digital tools.  Implement best practices for Cyber risk assessment in line with overall ARC processes and Functional Rules. Improve Cyber risk assessment processes by efficiency savings and reducing complexities. title: Assistant Human Resources Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 Business Unit: Delhi Department: Human Resources To align drive the Human resources function along with the business objectives / goals and provide a competitive sustainable HR framework for the unit. To develop people capabilities in the unit by selecting, retaining, compensating the best talent in the unit. To build a learning organization culture to foster a healthy climate for career enhancements employee aspirations in the unit 
 
 Essential Job Tasks 
 Monitoring and ensuring activities like recruitment, full final settlement, salary cycle, leave calculation, etc. takes place accurately and within as per given standards. Assessing the overall workforce requirement and forecast the attrition level; cushion the unit by making talent resourcing plans accordingly. Monitoring all the exits separations; strive for retaining the employees and study the reason of existing attrition. Regularly review all legal compliances and renew licenses as and when required. 
 
 Areas of Responsibility 
 
 Financials Strategy 
 Assist in preparing the annual payroll budget exercise for the hotel and ensure all statutory dues are incorporated. Assist in preparing the HR Strategy workbook and workforce plan for the hotel. Managing payroll activities and ensure no omission of data occurs. Ensure that all employee salaries and contractor wages are paid on time. 
 
 Associate Life-Cycle Management 
 Develop strategic sources of recruitment such as campus hiring, job portals, social media, internal mobility, role enhancements etc. Assist sign off on the salaries and terms and conditions of selected associates at all levels, supervise adherence to recruitment profile, timelines and budgets. Ensures timely disbursement of offer / intent letters, pre-employment formalities, appointment, confirmation, role enhancement letters to the employees concerned. title: Recruitment Team Lead - Non-IT Recruitment
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Recruitment Team Lead - Non-IT Recruitment to lead our recruitment team and manage end-to-end hiring for BPO, BFSI, Sales, Customer Support, Operations, Back Office, Field Operations, and other non-IT roles. The role will be responsible for team management, recruitment strategy, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, onboarding, recruitment MIS, and achieving hiring targets. The candidate should have strong hands-on recruitment experience and the ability to drive a team in a target-oriented environment. 
 Responsibilities 
 Recruitment Team Management - Lead and manage a team of recruiters. Allocate recruitment requirements and monitor individual recruiter performance. Set daily, weekly, and monthly hiring targets. Conduct regular team reviews and performance discussions. Coach recruiters on sourcing, screening, follow-ups, and closures. Track productivity, conversion ratios, and recruiter-wise performance. End-to-End Recruitment - Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requirement understanding to candidate onboarding. Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, databases, walk-ins, job fairs, and other channels. Screen candidates based on experience, skills, salary expectations, location, notice period, and role suitability. Coordinate interviews with HR and Operations teams. Manage offer discussions, documentation, joining follow-ups, and onboarding. Non-IT Hiring - Handle recruitment for roles such as: BPO / Call Centre Executives, Customer Support / Voice Non-Voice, Team Leaders / Operations Managers, Sales Business Development, Back Office / Data Entry, Field Operations, Finance Accounts, HR Administration, ATM / Banking Operations, Other business and support functions. Recruitment Planning Strategy - Understand manpower requirements from Operations and business teams. Develop sourcing plans based on volume, location, skill requirements, and joining timelines. Identify new recruitment channels to improve candidate availability. Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline. Plan bulk hiring drives and walk-in recruitment campaigns where required. Stakeholder Management - Work closely with Operations, HR, and business managers to understand hiring requirements. Ensure clear communication on open positions, candidate status, interview feedback, and joining plans. Escalate recruitment challenges and recommend corrective actions. Maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders. Recruitment MIS Reporting - Prepare and maintain daily/weekly/monthly recruitment reports covering: Open positions; Profiles sourced; Profiles screened; Profiles shortlisted; Interviews scheduled; Interviews completed; Offers released; Offers accepted; Candidates joined; Offer-to-join ratio; Source-wise hiring; Recruiter-wise productivity; Pending requirements; Attrition / early dropouts. Candidate Experience Joining Management - Ensure timely communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Minimize candidate dropouts between selection and joining. Conduct regular follow-ups with selected candidates. Identify reasons for offer declines and no-shows. Maintain a positive candidate experience. Key Performance Indicators 
 Monthly hiring target achievement Requirement closure TAT Recruiter productivity Interview-to-selection ratio Offer-to-joining ratio Joining conversion Quality of hire Recruitment source effectiveness Candidate dropout percentage Recruiter team performance Stakeholder satisfaction Qualifications Experience 
 Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage. 3-5 years of recruitment experience, preferably with experience in Non-IT/BPO/ITES hiring. Minimum 1-2 years of experience managing a recruitment team preferred. Experience handling bulk hiring and multiple locations will be an advantage. Experience with recruitment platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Apna, WorkIndia, and other sourcing channels will be preferred. Preferred Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate should be someone who can personally drive recruitment closures while effectively managing a team. Strong ownership, follow-up discipline, data-driven recruitment management, and the ability to work under hiring targets are essential.

title: Senior Manager  Human Resources
description:
Location: Hyderabad Organisation: Sri Vishnu Educational Society Employment Type: Full-time Compensation: Commensurate with experience, expertise and current compensation 
 About Sri Vishnu Educational Society Sri Vishnu Educational Society is a leading educational group operating multiple institutions across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. The Society offers education through engineering, pharmacy, dental, polytechnic, B.Sc., M.Sc., MCA and school programmes, as well as a dedicated Womens University. The group serves more than 25,000 students and has over 3,000 faculty and staff members. Its Head Office in Hyderabad. Position Overview The Society is looking for an experienced and capable Senior Manager Human Resources to lead and manage HR operations across the group. The selected candidate will be responsible for developing uniform HR policies, strengthening employee welfare, ensuring statutory compliance and supporting the institutions in recruitment, performance management, employee relations and workforce planning. The position requires a hands-on HR professional who can balance strategic responsibilities with effective execution across a large, geographically distributed educational organisation. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 HR Strategy and Governance Develop and implement a comprehensive HR strategy aligned with the Societys objectives. Establish standard HR policies, processes and documentation across all institutions and the Head Office. Advise senior management and institutional leadership on workforce planning, organisation structure and HR matters. Develop HR dashboards and MIS reports for periodic management review. Conduct regular HR audits across the institutions and monitor policy implementation.Talent Acquisition and Workforce Planning Define recruitment strategies for faculty, leadership, administrative, technical and support positions. Develop standard processes for manpower planning, recruitment, selection,onboarding, probation and confirmation. Establish appropriate policies for transfers, promotions, succession planning and employee separation. Work with institutional heads to identify current and future talent requirements. Strengthen employer branding and build effective recruitment channels for academic and non-academic positions. 
 Employee Welfare and Engagement 
 Design and implement employee-welfare initiatives across the Society. Develop programmes to improve employee engagement, satisfaction and retention. Establish effective grievance-redressal and employee-feedback mechanisms. Promote a positive, inclusive, respectful and performance-oriented work culture. Conduct periodic employee-engagement and satisfaction surveys and recommend improvements. 
 Statutory Compliance and Labour Laws 
 Ensure compliance with applicable central and state labour and employment laws. Manage statutory requirements relating to PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, maternity benefits, bonus and other employee benefits. Ensure compliance with the POSH Act and support the functioning of Internal Committees across the institutions. Maintain statutory registers, records, filings, notices and documentation. Coordinate with government departments, labour authorities, legal advisers,auditors and consultants when required. Monitor changes in employment legislation and recommend timely policy revisions. 
 Compensation, Benefits and Retirement Plans Develop and administer compensation structures, salary revisions and employee benefit programmes. Oversee payroll inputs and coordinate with the finance and accounts teams for timely and accurate salary processing. Manage PF, gratuity, pension or superannuation plans, insurance and other retirement benefits. Conduct compensation benchmarking and recommend competitive salary structures. Ensure accuracy and transparency in employee-benefit administration. 
 Performance and Employee Relations Design and implement performance-management systems for academic and nonacademic employees. Establish annual goal-setting, appraisal, promotion and increment processes. Guide institutional leadership in handling employee grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace conflicts. Develop fair and legally compliant procedures for performance improvement, disciplinary action and employee separation. Maintain confidentiality and ensure consistency in all employee-related decisions.Policies and HR Operations Develop and periodically review policies relating to leave, attendance, working hours, travel, transfers, deputation, promotions, conduct and discipline. Standardise HR documentation, including appointment letters, service agreements, confirmation letters and separation documents. Drive HR digitisation and effective use of HRMS platforms. Maintain accurate centralised employee records and HR databases. Coordinate closely with institutional HR teams and designated HR representatives. 
 Qualification and Experience MBA/PGDM with specialisation in Human Resources, Personnel Management or Industrial Relations from a recognised institution; or A graduate/postgraduate qualification in Law with substantial exposure to employment and labour laws; or An equivalent professional qualification supported by strong and relevant HR leadership experience. Preferably 10 or more years of progressive HR experience, including experience in a managerial or group-level role. Experience in a large educational group, university, multi-location organisation,hospital group, manufacturing company or corporate institution will be an advantage. Strong practical knowledge of labour laws, statutory compliance, employee benefits and HR policy administration is essential. 
 Contract Labour and Security Management 
 Oversee the engagement, deployment and administration of contract labour, outsourced personnel and security staff across all institutions and offices. Ensure contractor and vendor compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory wages, PF, ESI, insurance, licences, attendance records and other regulatory requirements. Coordinate manpower requirements, duty rosters, shift schedules, replacements and performance reviews with institutional heads and service providers. Monitor service-level agreements, vendor bills, employee verification, uniforms, training, workplace conduct and grievance resolution. Conduct periodic compliance and performance audits of contractors and security agencies and initiate corrective or contractual action wherever required. Establish standard procedures for campus security, access control, incident reporting and emergency coordination in consultation with institutional administration. 
 Desired Skills and Competencies 
 Strong understanding of strategic and operational HR management. Thorough knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance requirements. Ability to develop policies and implement them consistently across multiple institutions. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with confidentiality, fairness and maturity. Strong analytical, documentation, presentation and HR-MIS capabilities. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and HRMS platforms. Ability to communicate effectively in English; knowledge of Telugu and Hindi will be an advantage. Willingness to travel to institutions across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana when required. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate will be a mature and experienced HR professional who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. The candidate should be capable of working closely with the Society's senior management, institutional heads and HR teams to build a professional, compliant and employee-focused HR function across the group. 
 Job Location 
 Base Location: Hyderabad Travel: Frequent travel across the campuses in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh 
 How to Apply

 Current designation and organisation Total and relevant experience Current CTC Expected CTC Notice period Present location 

 Email subject : Application for Senior Manager, Human Resources Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussions.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Indian Payroll, Advanced Excel, Power BI, HRMS, statutory compliance, employee benefits, audit coordination, and HR operations, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deliver accurate and timely outputs within defined timelines. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Payroll Management 
 Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing, including salary computation, incentives, reimbursements, arrears, deductions, and full & final settlement. Manage payroll inputs, validation, payroll processing, payroll closure, and reconciliation with Finance. Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of payroll data and employee records. Handle employee payroll-related queries and resolve discrepancies within defined timelines. Prepare payroll MIS, analytics, dashboards, and management reports. Analyze payroll data to identify errors, trends, and opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization. 
 Statutory Compliance & Audit 
 Ensure compliance with applicable Indian payroll statutory requirements, including PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, LWF, TDS, Gratuity, Bonus, and other applicable labour laws. Prepare and file statutory returns, challans, and related documentation within prescribed timelines. Handle internal and external payroll/HR audits. Prepare audit data, supporting documents, reconciliations, and reports. Coordinate with internal/external auditors and provide timely responses to audit queries. Track and resolve audit observations and ensure appropriate closure. 
 Employee Benefits Management 
 Manage employee benefits such as GMC, GPA, Group Term Life Insurance, and other applicable employee benefit programs. Coordinate policy renewals, employee additions/deletions, endorsements, and related documentation. Address and resolve employee queries related to insurance and benefits. Coordinate with insurance/benefit vendors and ensure timely service delivery. Monitor vendor performance, policy timelines, and employee benefit records. 
 HRMS, Leave & Attendance 
 Manage and maintain employee data in HRMS, ensuring accuracy and timely updates. Handle HRMS-related employee transactions and coordinate with HRMS vendors for issue resolution. Manage Leave & Attendance processes, including attendance inputs, leave records, exceptions, and payroll integration. Support HRMS enhancements, system upgrades, automation, and process improvements. 
 Exit Management 
 Manage the employee exit process from initiation to closure. Handle Full & Final (F&F) settlement, including salary, leave encashment, deductions, recoveries, gratuity, and other applicable components. Coordinate with relevant HR, Finance, payroll, and other stakeholders for timely F&F closure. Address employee queries related to exit and settlement. 
 Vendor Management 
 Manage payroll, HRMS, employee benefits, and other HR-related vendors. Handle vendor onboarding, documentation, coordination, invoicing, and payment follow-ups. Monitor vendor deliverables, SLAs, service quality, and issue resolution. Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely and accurate payroll/HR operations. 
 Performance Management 
 Support and coordinate the annual appraisal/performance management cycle. Coordinate with HR, managers, employees, and other stakeholders for timely completion of appraisal activities. Ensure accurate processing and implementation of approved appraisal-related payroll inputs. 
 Stakeholder & Government Coordination 
 Effectively manage coordination with HR, Finance, Business/Functional teams, employees, vendors, and auditors. Coordinate with relevant government/statutory authorities for payroll and employee-related compliance matters. Ensure timely resolution of queries and adherence to organizational policies and statutory requirements. 
 Mandatory Skills & Competencies 
 Payroll & Compliance 
 Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end payroll processing. Strong knowledge of Indian payroll statutory compliance and labour laws. Experience with PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, TDS, Gratuity, Bonus, and other applicable statutory requirements. Experience in F&F Settlement and Exit Management. Experience handling payroll for medium to large employee strength. 
 Advanced Excel Mandatory 
 Pivot Tables Power Query Power Pivot VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP INDEX-MATCH IF, SUMIFS and other complex formulas Data validation, reconciliation, reporting, and automation 
 Power BI Mandatory 
 End-to-end dashboard creation Data modelling Basic DAX Payroll/HR analytics and MIS reporting 
 HR Operations 
 HRMS management Leave & Attendance Management Employee Benefits GMC, GPA, Insurance, etc. Policy renewal and vendor coordination Appraisal cycle coordination Employee query management 
 Audit & Vendor Management 
 Internal and external audit handling Audit data preparation and reconciliation Auditor coordination and query resolution Vendor onboarding and management Vendor invoicing and coordination 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Finance, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field. 58 years of relevant experience in Payroll & HR Operations, preferably in a medium to large organization. Experience with HRMS/payroll platforms and reporting tools will be an advantage.

title: Assistant Sales Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
E-Commerce Sales Manager
 Company: Talenteq Technology India Pvt. Ltd.
 Location: Surajpur Industrial Area, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 Department: Sales 
 Designation: E-Commerce Sales Manager
 Experience: 58 Years
 Industry Preference: LED Lighting / Electrical / Electronics / Solar / Consumer Durables / E-Commerce
 Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented E-Commerce Sales Manager to manage and grow our online sales business across major e-commerce marketplaces and digital channels.
The candidate will be responsible for developing e-commerce sales strategies, managing online marketplaces, improving product visibility, driving revenue, monitoring sales performance, and coordinating with internal teams for smooth order fulfillment.
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in LED lighting, electrical products, electronics, solar products, consumer durables, or similar product categories and a good understanding of platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, IndiaMART and other B2B/B2C marketplaces.
Key Responsibilities
 Develop and execute strategies to achieve e-commerce sales and revenue targets . Manage company presence and sales on Amazon, Flipkart, IndiaMART and other relevant marketplaces . Handle complete online product lifecycle including: Product listing and catalog creation
 Product descriptions and specifications
 Product images and content
 Pricing and promotional activities
 Inventory availability
 Order processing and fulfillment
 Monitor daily, weekly and monthly sales performance, revenue, orders, conversion rates and marketplace KPIs . Identify opportunities to increase product visibility, traffic and online sales. Plan and execute marketplace promotions, discounts, campaigns and advertisements . Monitor competitor pricing, products, reviews, offers and market trends. Coordinate with the Marketing, Warehouse, Production, Purchase and Accounts teams to ensure smooth order processing and timely delivery. Ensure accurate inventory and prevent stock-out and overstock situations . Analyze customer reviews, ratings and feedback and coordinate with relevant teams for improvement. Handle marketplace-related issues, claims, returns, cancellations and customer escalations. Prepare regular MIS reports and sales analysis for management. Track marketplace expenses, advertising spend and overall profitability. Develop strategies for improving ROAS, conversion rate and marketplace profitability . Explore new online sales channels and business opportunities. Lead and guide the e-commerce sales team, if applicable. Required Skills
Strong knowledge of E-Commerce Sales & Marketplace Management.
 Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central / Flipkart Seller Hub / IndiaMART or similar platforms .
 Good understanding of B2B and B2C online sales .
 Experience in managing product catalogs and online listings.
 Strong knowledge of digital marketing, marketplace advertising and promotions .
 Excellent analytical and reporting skills.
 Good knowledge of MS Excel including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, MIS and sales analysis.
 Strong negotiation, communication and coordination skills.
 Ability to analyze competitors and market trends.
 Target-oriented approach with strong business and commercial understanding.
 
Preferred Industry Experience
 Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:
 LED Lighting
 Electrical & Electronics
 Solar Products
 Consumer Electronics
 Electrical Accessories
 Home Appliances
 Consumer Durables
 Hardware / Building Products
 E-Commerce / Marketplace Business
Qualification
 Graduate in any discipline.
 MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Sales or E-Commerce will be an added advantage.
Experience
 58 years of relevant experience , preferably in E-Commerce Sales / Marketplace Management.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 Monthly E-Commerce Revenue
 Order Volume & Sales Growth
 Marketplace Conversion Rate
 Product Ranking & Visibility
 Advertising ROI / ROAS
 Marketplace Profitability
 Inventory Availability
 Return & Cancellation Rate
 Customer Rating & Reviews
 New Marketplace/Channel Development
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a hands-on E-Commerce professional who can independently manage online marketplaces, develop sales strategies, analyze business data and deliver measurable revenue growth.
Candidates with proven experience in LED lights, indoor/outdoor lighting, solar lighting or electrical products will be highly preferred.
Salary
 As per industry standards and candidate's experience/skill set.

Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities. Ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation/customer success teams. 6. Sales Forecasting & Reporting Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reports. Provide regular updates to senior management on sales performance. Track opportunities through the CRM system. Analyse pipeline health, win/loss ratios, sales cycles, and revenue projections. Prepare periodic sales reports and management dashboards. 7. Prior experience in a Sales Manager / Team Lead / Sales Leadership role. Proven experience in managing and achieving sales targets. Strong exposure to Enterprise Sales and consultative selling . Experience selling SaaS, technology products, enterprise applications, procurement technology, supply chain solutions, ERP, or similar B2B technology solutions will be preferred. Strong understanding of the complete enterprise sales lifecycle. Experience managing CXO-level and senior stakeholder relationships. Strong negotiation, presentation, communication, and influencing skills. Excellent pipeline management and forecasting capabilities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working with CRM tools and sales analytics. Preferred Experience Candidates with experience in selling solutions to the following functions/industries will be preferred: Procurement Supply Chain Finance Manufacturing Retail Logistics Enterprise Technology ERP / Enterprise Applications SaaS / Cloud Solutions Digital Transformation Key Competencies Leadership & Team Management Enterprise Selling SaaS Sales Consultative Selling Strategic Account Management Business Development Negotiation & Closing Pipeline Management Revenue Forecasting Client Relationship Management Stakeholder Management Commercial Acumen Communication & Presentation Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The successful candidate will be measured on: Achievement of monthly/quarterly/annual sales targets New customer acquisition Revenue generation Enterprise deal closures Sales pipeline value and quality Conversion/win rate Average deal size Sales cycle management Team performance and productivity Customer/strategic account growth What We Are Looking For We are looking for a hands-on sales leader who can not only manage a team but also actively participate in enterprise sales, build strategic relationships, identify opportunities, and close high-value SaaS deals. description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager, Agri SaaS and ERP
 Company: PanApps
 Location: India (Remote), with occasional domestic and international travel 
 Experience: 3 to 6 years 
 About the Role 
 PanApps builds PanAgro, an agribusiness ERP platform used by large plantation organisations in India and internationally for over a decade. We are expanding the platform into a portfolio of SaaS and ERP products for agribusinesses of every size. We are hiring a Business Development Manager to drive growth across Indian and international markets. The role combines hands-on selling with shaping and executing go-to-market strategy. 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Business Development and Sales 
 Prospect and build a qualified pipeline of agribusiness clients, including plantations, estates, cooperatives, exporters and agri-enterprises. Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, demonstrations, pilots, proposals, negotiation and closure. Run consultative discovery with operations, finance, IT and ownership stakeholders, and match client needs to the right product. Deliver product demonstrations based on the client's actual operating scenarios. Plan and manage pilots with defined success criteria, and convert them into paid contracts. Prepare proposals, quotations and commercial terms with the pre-sales and product teams. Contribute to RFP and tender responses. Develop early adopter and reference clients into case studies and testimonials. Relay client feedback and market gaps to the product team. Maintain CRM records and report weekly on pipeline, forecast and deal progress. Meet targets for pipeline, pilots and revenue. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in business, agriculture, engineering or a related field. An MBA is an advantage. 3 to 6 years in B2B business development or sales for a software product, including at least 2 years selling ERP or comparably complex enterprise software. Experience limited to simple CRM or transactional SaaS does not qualify. Proven experience selling to both Indian and international clients. Track record of closing multi-stakeholder deals involving demos, pilots or proofs of concept. Hands-on exposure to GTM planning, market entry or campaign execution. Understanding of business workflows such as inventory, procurement, costing, payroll inputs and approvals. Strong written and spoken English. Willingness to travel, including to remote plantation areas and overseas markets. Desired Qualifications Experience with agri ERP, farm management or agritech platforms. Knowledge of plantation crops such as tea, coffee, rubber, spices, palm oil, others. Market exposure to East Africa, South and south-east Asia, EU, or Latin America. Familiarity with agri compliance and certification standards such as EUDR, Rainforest Alliance, Fairtrade and organic. Experience with both product-led SaaS and enterprise sales.

title: Regional Manager - Core Lab
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Regional Manager you will be active in field travel with all members of the team on a regular basis. Coaching and written feedback to team members after each field travel is expected in an effort to develop all Zonal Managers to their highest potential in both, Sales Strategy as well as how to most effectively navigate West Region as well as the multitude of field resources at each individual contributors disposal. Collaborate with Application, Marketing, Service, Key Account, Workflow Team, Clinical Value Team, Medical Scientific Affairs 
 Your Opportunity 
 1) Business Development and Sales Evaluate the market environment, estimate the Demand and competitive analysis Responsible for Budget preparation. Financial responsibility for budgeting, sales analysis, forecasting and profitability, develop and handle the yearly/quarterly budget for all areas of responsibility Prepare monthly sales plan & estimate the inventory requirement at C & F level Review sales & provide rolling analysis every month Management of the top line sales and gross margins in their region Responsible for directing all of the activities in Marketing, Sales for Business in the particular region Development of sales, sales channels, Sales promotional items and activities and sales support Identifying and network with key / large customers (with volume Business) and form relationship, thereby promoting business Responsible for the total Business in the region for new and existing customers 2) Execution of Marketing Plan Responsible for Business Analysis and planning for new product launches Execution of the sales promotion plan through his sales force in each territory and supervising the same Development and Implementation of Regional Specific Strategies Make a proper record of all the sales promotion activities and their expenses along with the sales generated from the promotions (feedback on efficacy of the various campaigns) Responsible for driving Regional Marketing activities (CME, Conference participation) 3) People Management Ensure Monthly Review of Sales and Collection Performance and provide timely feedback, Coaching vis a vis Targets and initiate corrective actions , guidance and support to his team members in case of deviations Reporting Authority and Team Leader for entire Regional Sales Team Monitor all expenses at the Regional Level pertaining to his sales team Act as a link between Management Expectations and field force needs. Address all the complaints / suggestions received from the distributor s /dealers/ customers or any other government or non-government agencies To have a collaborative approach. 4) Others Monitor all compliances relating to product Placement, IPC compliance, documentation, reporting in clarify, and manage critical customer issues Conducting Regional Team Meetings every quarter Responsible for recruitment of the sales Team Management of Regional expenses-travel, marketing within allocated budgets Generate Reports in Clarify Who You Are: You hold a bachelors degree and 12+ years of experience in Core Lab, of which at least 5 years should be in a Multinational Company and to evidence your success in service delivery; a proven track record of developing strong relationships with key stakeholders to the highest decision making level leading to successful business outcomes You demonstrate successful and considerable consistent track record in leading people, preferably acquired in the healthcare industry You demonstrate a strategic problem solver with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to prioritize and deliver, you can lead change and adoption of new concepts With confidence and passion, you will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and be able to communicate with maximum impact Resilient, tenacious, you strive under pressure, working effectively as part of a close-knit team in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment with shifting priorities and multiple deadlines. With strong analytical skills, you are at ease working with technical and scientific information This position offers exposure to wider Roche organization at all levels and therefore you must have the qualities to make a positive, professional impact in a matrix environment and win the hearts and minds internally Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100 000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. 
Let s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer. "

title: Outreach Officer
description:
CBM India Trust is committed to improving the quality of life of people with disabilities. CBM India addresses disability as a cause and consequence of poverty in the most disadvantaged communities of the world. We work in partnership with local, national, and international actors with the aim of creating a more equitable society for all. Our vision is to have an inclusive world in which all persons with disabilities enjoy their human rights and achieve their full potential. Position: Outreach Officer Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai Department: Retail Fundraising Reporting to: City Manager Experience: 3-5 Years Start Date: Immediate Objective: We are seeking a dynamic, proactive, and mission-driven Outreach Officer to enable our face-to-face (F2F) fundraisers to engage with potential donors in high-trust, high-traffic venues such as corporate parks, malls, airports, RWAs, metro stations, exhibitions, and other strategic spaces that require formal permissions. This role is key to enhancing the safety, efficiency, and dignity of our fundraising efforts-moving fundraisers off the streets and into trusted environments that encourage donor engagement and foster long-term support for CBM India s programs. 
 Responsibilities: 1.Venue Acquisition Permissions - Identify and acquire permissions for fundraising at potential outreach venues including corporates, gated communities, metro stations, shopping malls, airports, exhibitions, and more. - Build a robust pipeline of outreach locations using research, referrals, direct walk-ins, and cold calling. - Prepare and present compelling proposals about CBM India s campaigns to venue management and CSR heads. - Track and report the permission status across all targeted venues. 2. Outreach Planning Execution - Develop and implement city-level outreach strategies aligned with fundraising goals. - Schedule and manage outreach events, ensuring compliance with organizational - Ensure that every outreach event is well-organized, donor-friendly, and aligned with 3. Relationship Building Engagement - Cultivate long-term partnerships with key decision-makers in corporates, public infrastructure authorities, event organizers, and RWAs. - Act as a liaison between CBM India and venue stakeholders to build trust and facilitate repeat engagements. - Leverage existing relationships to seek referrals to other potential venues. 4. Team Collaboration Capacity Building - Coordinate closely with City Managers, Outreach Managers, and Fundraising teams to align outreach efforts with broader campaign objectives. - Guide F2F fundraisers on messaging strategies tailored to each venue. - Facilitate training and knowledge sharing across outreach staff to build a culture of 5. Decision-Making Authority - Independently decide on outreach schedules, event planning, and allocation of fundraisers at venues. - Recommend cancellation of outreach events if they do not align with campaign or safety standards (with appropriate consultation). - Approve local expenses for outreach activities within defined limits in consultation with 
 Required Skills Qualifications - 3-5 years of experience in B2B Sales, CSR outreach, corporate partnerships, or event management. - Experience in venue acquisition, outreach coordination, or fundraising preferred. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present ideas convincingly. - Strong networking and interpersonal abilities to engage and build trust with stakeholders. - Proficient in MS Office, internet research, and social media platforms. - High motivation to contribute to a cause and passion for social impact work. Desirable Attributes - Empathy and understanding of social issues, particularly disability inclusion and  human rights. - Strong planning and organizational capabilities. - Confidence in public speaking and proposal pitching. - Ability to work independently, take initiative, and deliver results under pressure Tools Travel Requirements - A two-wheeler (preferred) for city travel and venue visits. - Willingness to travel locally and occasionally between cities. 
 Who You ll Work with Contact Type Frequency Purpose Outreach Team As needed Knowledge sharing, team execution External Venues/Corps Daily Outreach permission, relationship building Why Work with CBM India - Be part of a mission-driven organization impacting lives across India. - Enjoy meaningful work that opens new pathways for ethical and dignified fundraising. - Collaborate with a diverse and inclusive team that values innovation, compassion, and resilience. - Opportunities for learning, growth, and national exposure in India s development Other requirements The future job holder is expected to adhere to CBM India s policies and procedures, commit to CBM India s Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct, and follow CBM India s safety security protocols.

description:
Job Description Accounts Executive Position: Accounts Executive
 Department: Accounts & Finance
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Industry Preference: Jewellery Industry preferred Location: Byculla 
 Job Summary We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accounts Executive to join our Accounts & Finance team. The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day accounting entries, payment and receipt processing, petty cash management, stock reconciliation, and ensuring accurate accounting treatment of GST and TDS . The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of accounting principles, practical experience in Tally , and the ability to independently handle routine accounting and reconciliation activities. Experience in the jewellery/manufacturing industry will be an added advantage. Key Responsibilities 1. Purchase & Sales Accounting Recording and maintaining purchase and sales invoices in the accounting system. Ensuring proper accounting classification and accurate ledger posting. Verifying invoices, supporting documents, quantities, rates, and applicable taxes before posting. Ensuring timely and accurate accounting of purchase and sales transactions. 2. Debit Note & Credit Note Preparation and accounting of Debit Notes and Credit Notes . Verifying the supporting documents and reasons for issuance. Ensuring appropriate accounting and GST treatment for such transactions. 3. Payments & Receipts Preparing and processing payments to vendors and other parties as per approved instructions. Posting payment entries in the accounting system after processing. Recording and reconciling receipt entries against customer outstanding balances. Maintaining proper documentation and supporting records for all payments and receipts. Assisting in vendor and customer ledger reconciliation. 4. Petty Cash Management Maintaining and managing the petty cash on a day-to-day basis. Recording petty cash expenses accurately and ensuring proper supporting bills/vouchers. Performing regular petty cash reconciliation and maintaining appropriate records. Ensuring expenses are accounted for under the correct ledger heads. 5. Stock Reconciliation Performing regular stock reconciliation between the accounting system and manufacturing software. Reconciling gold, jewellery and other relevant inventory records. Identifying and investigating discrepancies in stock quantities and values. Coordinating with the Production, Stores and Accounts teams for resolution of differences. Ensuring timely correction of accounting or system-related discrepancies. 6. GST & TDS Compliance Ensuring the correct GST treatment is applied to purchase, sales, debit note, credit note, expense and other accounting entries. Ensuring appropriate TDS applicability, deduction and accounting for relevant transactions. Verifying GSTIN, tax rates, taxable values and other relevant tax details before posting entries. Supporting the senior accounts team in GST/TDS reconciliations and compliance-related activities. 7. General Accounting Maintaining accurate and up-to-date accounting records. Passing journal and other routine accounting entries as required. Assisting in ledger scrutiny, reconciliations and month-end closing activities . Maintaining proper filing and documentation of accounting records. Coordinating with internal departments for accounting-related information and supporting documents. Assisting seniors in audits and providing required information and documents. Required Skills & Qualifications Graduate in B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. Good working knowledge of Tally Prime and MS Excel. Practical knowledge of GST and TDS accounting. Strong reconciliation and analytical skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality of financial and business information. Good coordination and communication skills. Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with different departments. Preferred Experience Candidates having experience with gold/jewellery stock reconciliation will have an added advantage. Experience in working with manufacturing or inventory management software integrated with accounting systems will be preferred. 
 Immediate joiners Preferred / Candidates staying in South/Central Mumbai preferred.

description:
ASST MANAGER/ MANAGER - OUTREACH AND PARTNERSHIPS 
 The School of Sports Science at Universal Ai University, Karjat, is seeking an Assistant Manager/Manager - Outreach and Partnerships to drive institutional partnerships, grassroots outreach, and student recruitment for its undergraduate programs. This is a relationship-first, target-driven role that sits at the intersection of business development, institutional liaison, and admissions marketing. The incumbent will build and manage a network of sports bodies, academies, athletes, healthcare and rehabilitation institutions, schools, and coaching centres, and will convert that network into visibility, credibility, and enrolments for the program 
 JOB ROLE: Institutional Liaison & Partnership Building Identify, approach, and build formal tie-ups with private and government-backed sports bodies, federations, and associations. Develop working relationships with sports academies, training centres, clubs, and individual athletes for collaborations, endorsements, and student exposure opportunities. Establish partnerships with hospitals, physiotherapy clinics, and rehabilitation centres to support clinical exposure, internships, and applied learning tie-ups. Draft, negotiate, and coordinate MOUs and partnership agreements in consultation with the Deans office, and track their renewal and compliance status. Represent the School at sporting events, tournaments, conclaves, and industry forums to build the institutions presence and network. Schools & Coaching Academies Outreach Network Build and maintain a structured database of schools, junior colleges, and coaching/training academies for sustained outreach. Plan and execute outreach programs, talks, demo sessions, and campus visits at partner schools and coaching centres. Coordinate with school sports departments, physical education teachers, and coaches to position the University as a preferred pathway for student-athletes. Admissions Marketing & Student Counselling Market and promote the undergraduate Sports Science programs to prospective students across schools, academies, and outreach events. Own lead generation, counselling support, and conversion targets for the school in coordination with the central admissions team. Interact directly with parents to address concerns, build trust, and communicate career pathways, placement outcomes, and program value. Support the creation and distribution of marketing collateral, brochures, and digital content in coordination with the marketing team. Brand Building & Program Positioning Create visibility and aura for the Sports Science program among athletes, coaches, schools, and the broader sporting ecosystem. Coordinate athlete/coach appearances, guest sessions, and co-branded events that reinforce the programs credibility. Gather feedback from partners and prospects to inform program positioning and outreach strategy. LOCATION : Universal Ai Campus, Karjat. This position will also involve travel. 
 
 CANDIDATE PROFILE: Education MBA preferred (Marketing/Sales or General Management); graduates with strong, demonstrable sales experience will also be considered. Experience Proven experience in sales - institutional, B2B, or education/admissions sales - is essential; 4-8 years overall experience, with the higher end of the range for Manager level. Outreach, business development, or partnership/liaison experience (schools, academies, sports federations, education counselling) is preferred but not mandatory. Candidates with a sports background, or a genuine passion for sports and fitness, will be strongly preferred. Skills & Attributes Outgoing, personable, and confident - comfortable initiating and building relationships with new people across varied settings. Strong selling ability with a track record of meeting targets; persuasive communicator with a confident public-facing presence for school talks, events, and parent interactions. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills across diverse stakeholders - government bodies, private academies, athletes, hospitals, school administrators, and parents. Target-oriented mindset with the discipline to manage a structured outreach pipeline and CRM/database. Willingness to travel extensively within the region for meetings, events, and outreach visits. 
 WHAT S ON OFFER: An opportunity to shape a growing School of Sports Science and build its ecosystem from the ground up. Direct exposure to leading sports bodies, academies, and athletes A collaborative environment with significant ownership and visibility to senior leadership

title: Sr. Executive - Digital Marketing (Salesforce Certification Mandatory)
description:
We are looking at least any 1 of the below certifications as mandatory: Salesforce sales cloud Certification Salesforce Marketing Cloud Certification 
 The role will primarily focus on Salesforce Sales Cloud and Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) , managing customer and lead data, email campaigns, journeys, segmentation, automation, reporting, and CRM-led engagement programs. The role will also require a strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem to ensure CRM initiatives are aligned with paid media, SEO, website, social media, analytics, and overall customer journey objectives. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across marketing and technology teams , translating business requirements into effective CRM and marketing automation solutions, and using data and insights to improve customer engagement and lead conversion. Key Responsibilities Salesforce Sales Cloud & CRM Management Manage and support day-to-day Salesforce Sales Cloud activities related to leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, and campaign data. Understand lead lifecycle management from lead generation through qualification, nurturing, conversion, and sales handoff . Support CRM data segmentation, cleansing, validation, and quality management. Work closely with sales teams to understand lead management requirements and improve CRM processes. Configure and maintain campaign-related data, audience segments, and CRM workflows in collaboration with Salesforce teams. Support integration and data movement between Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, website, digital channels, and other marketing platforms . Identify opportunities to improve lead management, customer engagement, and CRM-driven conversion. Assist in troubleshooting data, campaign, automation, and integration-related issues. Salesforce Marketing Cloud & Marketing Automation Plan, build, execute, and optimize email marketing campaigns and customer journeys using Salesforce Marketing Cloud . Work across SFMC capabilities including Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Contact Builder, and Data Extensions . Build audience segments and targeted communication based on customer behavior, lifecycle stage, demographics, engagement, and CRM attributes. Create and manage automated customer journeys including welcome, nurture, engagement, re-engagement, lead nurturing, and lifecycle campaigns . Support email campaign development, testing, scheduling, deployment, and post-campaign analysis. Manage data extensions, SQL queries, segmentation logic, campaign automation, and audience refreshes. Implement personalization, dynamic content, A/B testing, and campaign optimization initiatives. Monitor campaign performance across deliverability, open rate, click-through rate, engagement, conversion, and unsubscribe metrics . Use SFMC analytics and reporting to identify opportunities for campaign and journey optimization. Support integration of WhatsApp and other customer engagement channels with CRM and marketing automation initiatives. Knowledge of CleverTap or similar platforms is an added advantage. Ensure CRM and marketing automation activities follow applicable data privacy, consent, and communication governance requirements. Digital Marketing & Analytics Maintain a strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem, including SEO, paid media, social media, website, content, analytics, and digital customer journeys . Collaborate with SEO and performance marketing teams to align CRM campaigns with acquisition and conversion strategies. Support audience creation and activation using insights from paid media, website, CRM, and customer behavior. Analyze digital and CRM performance using tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Power BI, or similar platforms . Develop campaign performance reports and provide actionable insights to improve engagement, lead quality, and conversion. Support integrated campaigns across email, paid media, website, social, and CRM channels. Stay updated on emerging trends in marketing automation, AI-driven personalization, CRM, customer data, and digital marketing . Qualifications Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Marketing, Technology, or a related field. 6+ years of experience in digital marketing, CRM, marketing automation, or related roles. Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) . Working knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud , particularly leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns, and lead lifecycle management. Understanding of CRM data structures, audience segmentation, customer journeys, and marketing automation. Working knowledge of digital marketing channels including SEO, paid search, paid social, social media, website, and analytics . Experience with GA4 / Adobe Analytics, GTM, GSC, Power BI, or similar analytics and reporting platforms is preferred. Salesforce certification is preferred. Key Competencies Strong hands-on Salesforce CRM and Marketing Automation capability. Good understanding of the complete digital marketing ecosystem . Strong analytical and data-driven mindset. Ability to translate business requirements into CRM and marketing automation solutions. Strong understanding of customer lifecycle and lead nurturing. Attention to detail, particularly around CRM data, campaign execution, and automation. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work effectively with Sales, Marketing, IT, Analytics, and external technology partners . Ownership mindset with a focus on campaign quality, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes. Ability to learn and adapt to evolving digital marketing and marketing technology platforms.

title: Sr Sales Executive, Unified Commerce (US Market)
description:
Job Summary 
 EvinceDev is looking for a Senior Sales Executive to lead our ecommerce business in the United States. You will work directly with ecommerce founders, owners and technology leaders, and own each deal from the first conversation to the signed agreement. Most of our engagements begin with a free technical audit of the merchant s store. You will present those findings in plain business terms, recommend the right next step, and convert the conversation into a monthly support retainer or a migration and integration project. 
 
 Education Qualification 
 Bachelor or Master Degree 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Own the full sales cycle for US ecommerce accounts: prospecting, discovery, audit review, proposal, negotiation and closure. Run live findings sessions with founders, COOs, IT Managers and Ecommerce Managers, and guide them to a clear decision. Explain platform and integration risks in business terms such as lost revenue, compliance exposure, order errors and manual effort. Qualify accounts carefully so that senior architect time is spent on the right opportunities. Scope integration work across ERP, OMS, PIM, 3PL, POS, subscription billing and payment systems. Prepare and present proposals for monthly retainers and fixed scope migration or integration projects, with a support plan attached to every project. Give honest advice, including recommending that a merchant stays on the current platform when that is the better choice. Work with solution architects and delivery leads to confirm scope before sharing any estimate. Keep pipeline, forecasts and account notes up to date in HubSpot CRM. Turn completed engagements into case studies and share market feedback with the marketing team. Build relationships with platform partners, agencies and app vendors in the US ecommerce market to create a steady referral channel. 
 
 Must Have Skills 
 Communication and Presentation Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear and confident style suited to US founders, CTOs and CIOs. Strong presentation skills in live client meetings. Candidates will present a mock audit to a US ecommerce owner during the interview. Ability to handle tough questions from experienced business owners who have worked with several agencies before. Clear business writing for proposals, findings summaries and follow up emails. Availability to work with a large overlap with US business hours, including evening calls. 
 
 Ecommerce Sales Experience 
 5+ years of selling ecommerce services, platforms or commerce technology to US clients, with closed deals you can walk us through. Deals closed as projects of USD 50,000 or more, or as retainers of USD 3,000 to 8,000 per month. Experience handling the full sales cycle personally, from first contact to signed contract. Experience selling to founder led businesses with annual revenue between USD 3M and USD 50M. Experience in consultative selling, where the client first needs to understand the problem before buying a solution. 
 
 Platform Knowledge 
 Good working knowledge of Magento and Adobe Commerce, Shopify and Shopify Plus, and WooCommerce, including the strengths and limits of each. Ability to discuss platform end of life, checkout and subscription setups, and B2B feature gaps without needing an engineer on the call. Understanding of B2B commerce needs such as company accounts, quotes, credit limits, purchase order approvals, tiered pricing and minimum order quantities. Understanding of what drives migration cost and timelines, and why a paid discovery is needed before a firm quote. 
 
 Integration and Unified Commerce 
 Experience selling integration led or unified commerce projects, in addition to website builds. Knowledge of ERP, OMS, PIM, WMS, 3PL and POS integrations, including systems such as NetSuite, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics, Acumatica, Epicor, Infor and QuickBooks Enterprise. Familiarity with subscription billing, payments, tax and fraud services, site search, and email and SMS platforms. Ability to spot where data breaks between systems, such as order sync, inventory, customer records and pricing, and to scope the fix. Ability to explain the value of connected systems in terms of order accuracy, stock accuracy, time saved and customer experience. 
 
 Ownership 
 Self driven approach to building target lists, managing your calendar and running your pipeline. Consistent follow up across long sales cycles, with a personal tone in every message. Accurate records in HubSpot CRM at all times. Comfortable working against revenue and pipeline targets. 
 
 Primary Skills Tools 
 Executive Presentation, Client Communication, Consultative Selling Ecommerce Platforms: Magento, Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, WooCommerce Integration Scoping: ERP, OMS, PIM, 3PL, POS, Subscriptions, Payments Unified Commerce, Proposal Writing, Deal Closure, Account Growth 
 
 Good To Have 
 Experience with an ecommerce agency, systems integrator, or commerce platform or app company. An existing network of US merchants, agencies, platform partners or app vendors. Partner programme experience with Shopify Plus, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools or similar. Exposure to headless or composable commerce. Experience selling to B2B distribution, wholesale, manufacturing or franchise businesses. Knowledge of subscription commerce, including failed payments and churn. Ability to read a platform scan or version report without help. Contribution to case studies, webinars or industry events. Hands on use of StoreLeads, BuiltWith, Apollo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

 Job Purpose To drive sales, profitability, and operational excellence across a network of Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs). description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life The Strategic Key Accounts team is responsible for developing and expanding relationships with large, complex healthcare organizations and strategic customers. This function partners across commercial, marketing, and business unit teams to align account strategies with customer priorities, identify growth opportunities, and support long-term business partnerships. The role focuses on portfolio growth, market share expansion, strategic account planning, and value-based customer engagement. 
This position is based in Chennai, India and operates in a remote work environment. The role requires approximately 30% travel to customer sites, internal meetings, and key stakeholder engagements across the assigned territory. 
Job Description field
The Strategic Key Accounts Manager is responsible for managing strategic healthcare accounts, building executive-level customer relationships, and driving business growth through account planning, portfolio expansion, and commercial execution. This role collaborates with internal stakeholders and customer leadership teams to identify opportunities, develop account-specific strategies, and support achievement of business objectives across assigned accounts. 
 Primary Responsibilities Develop and maintain relationships with senior executives and key decision-makers within strategic healthcare accounts. Create and execute account plans aligned with customer priorities, business objectives, and growth targets. Identify, qualify, and advance new business opportunities within assigned strategic accounts. Collaborate with business units, marketing, and cross-functional teams to implement account strategies and customer programs. Analyze customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive activity to recommend solutions that support account growth. Negotiate and support long-term contractual agreements that strengthen customer relationships and expand portfolio adoption. Monitor account performance, sales results, and opportunity pipelines to achieve revenue and market share objectives. Provide customer and market insights to support strategic planning, pricing discussions, and business decision-making. Required Qualifications High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 10+ years experience OR Associate s Degree AND 8+ years experience OR Bachelor s Degree AND 6+ years experience. Experience managing strategic or enterprise-level customer accounts with responsibility for revenue growth and relationship management. Experience engaging with C-suite executives, hospital leadership teams, and procurement stakeholders. Experience developing and executing account plans, business reviews, and customer engagement strategies. Demonstrated ability to influence senior customer stakeholders and manage complex sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers. Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% within the assigned territory. Preferred Qualifications Experience working within the medical device, healthcare technology, life sciences, or healthcare services industry. Demonstrated success leading complex negotiations and supporting contractual business agreements. Experience collaborating across multiple business units and cross-functional teams to deliver customer solutions. Knowledge of healthcare market trends, hospital operations, and strategic account management methodologies. of relevant sales and leadership experience. Physical Job Requirements

title: Digital Marketing Manager Fashion
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Digital Marketing Manager Fashion | Big Hello Location: Bengaluru Experience: 4–5 Years Department: Marketing / Digital Role: Digital Marketing Manager Employment: Full-time, On-site About Big Hello Big Hello – The Plus Life is India’s most loved plus-size fashion brand, built to change the way India experiences fashion. With 35 stores to experience, Big Hello offers stylish, contemporary fashion for Men & Women in sizes up to 7XL. We are looking for a Digital Marketing professional from the Fashion / Apparel / Lifestyle industry who can take ownership of our digital presence, social media content, and performance marketing across Meta and Google Ads. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Social Media & Content Plan and manage Big Hello's social media calendar across Instagram, Facebook and other relevant platforms. Develop daily/weekly social posts, campaigns, reels, stories and promotional content in collaboration with the creative team. Translate fashion collections, launches, offers and brand stories into engaging digital content. Coordinate with designers, photographers, influencers and internal teams for content creation. Track social media performance and continuously improve engagement and reach. Ensure a consistent Big Hello brand voice and visual identity across all digital touchpoints. 2. Meta Ads Independently manage the Meta Ads Manager / Business Manager account. Plan, launch and optimize campaigns for: New Customer Acquisition Retargeting Catalog Sales Website Conversion Collection / Product Launches Promotional & Seasonal Campaigns Manage audience segmentation, campaign structure, creatives, budgets and ROAS. Continuously test audiences, creatives, formats, offers and messaging. Monitor daily performance and take corrective actions to improve ROAS, CAC, CTR, CVR and revenue. 3. Google Ads Manage Big Hello's Google Ads account across relevant campaign types. Handle Performance Max, Search, Shopping and remarketing campaigns. Manage budgets, product feeds, audiences, keywords and campaign optimization. Monitor ROAS, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, revenue and customer acquisition. Identify opportunities to scale high-performing campaigns while controlling acquisition costs. 4. Fashion & E-commerce Marketing Understand the fashion customer journey from discovery consideration purchase repeat purchase. Work closely with the Design, Merchandising, E-commerce and Sales teams. Create digital campaigns around: New Arrivals Festive Collections Denim Shirts Occasion Wear Seasonal Campaigns Sale / Promotional Events Understand fashion trends, customer behaviour and product storytelling. 5. Analytics & Reporting Prepare weekly and monthly digital marketing performance reports. Track: Revenue ROAS CAC AOV CTR CPC CVR Traffic New vs. Returning Customers Campaign-level performance Use data to identify what is working and recommend actions for improvement. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS 4–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing. Mandatory experience in Fashion / Apparel / Lifestyle / E-commerce. Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager. Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads / Performance Max / Shopping. Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets and performance targets. Good understanding of social media content and fashion communication. Strong understanding of e-commerce marketing and conversion funnels. Experience with Instagram, Facebook and social media analytics. Good knowledge of Google Analytics / GA4 and e-commerce analytics. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work closely with creative teams and understand fashion imagery, styling and brand communication. Strong communication and project management skills. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone who is not just an Ads Manager, but someone who understands the complete digital fashion ecosystem. The ideal candidate should be able to look at a collection and understand: What should we communicate? Who should we target? Which creative should we use? Where should we advertise? What budget should we allocate? What is the result? You should be creative + analytical + commercially driven, with a strong understanding of fashion and digital consumers. Key Competencies Fashion Understanding | Social Media | Meta Ads | Google Ads | E-commerce | Performance Marketing | Content | Analytics | Customer Acquisition | ROAS EDUCATION Bachelor's / Master's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Fashion, Business or a related field.

Job Title: Account Executive & Office Administration Location: Badlapur Project Site, Mumbai & Other Locations
 Department: Accounts & Administration
 Reporting To: Accounts Head & Head Office Management
 Industry: Construction / Real Estate / Infrastructure Position Summary We are seeking a proactive and highly organized Account Executive & Office Administration Executive to manage site-level accounting, administration, procurement coordination, vendor management, compliance documentation, and office operations for our construction project at Badlapur, Mumbai. The candidate will act as the single point of coordination between the project site and Head Office, ensuring smooth execution of accounting, administrative, HR, procurement, and compliance activities. He should have high ethics and integrity to ensure correct information and data. Key Responsibilities A. Accounts & Finance Maintain site-level accounts, vouchers, petty cash, and expense records. Process vendor bills, invoices, and payment documentation. Verify and maintain purchase records, delivery challans, and GRNs. Reconcile petty cash, advances, and site expenditures. Coordinate with Head Office Accounts Team for payments, taxation, and accounting entries. Maintain accurate records of project expenditures and budget tracking. Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports for management review. Support audits and statutory compliance documentation. B. Vendor Management & Contracts Coordinate onboarding of vendors and subcontractors. Prepare and maintain Vendor Agreements, Work Orders (WO), Purchase Orders (PO), and Service Contracts. Track vendor performance, billing, and payment status. Maintain vendor database and contract records. Ensure proper documentation and approvals before issuing POs and WOs. Follow up with vendors regarding deliveries, invoices, and compliance requirements. C. Procurement & Store Management Manage procurement of construction materials, consumables, office supplies, and equipment. Obtain quotations and prepare comparative statements. Coordinate material delivery schedules with project teams. Maintain stock registers and inventory records. Monitor material consumption and prepare replenishment requests. Ensure proper receipt, storage, and issuance of materials. Conduct periodic stock verification and reconciliation. D. Office Administration Manage all day-to-day office administration activities at the project site. Maintain office records, files, registers, and correspondence. Manage office assets, equipment, stationery, and consumables. Coordinate travel arrangements, vehicle management, and accommodation requirements. Maintain vehicle logbooks, fuel records, and usage reports. Coordinate housekeeping, security, and facility management activities. E. Labour & HR Compliance Maintain labour attendance and manpower records. Coordinate labour license documentation and compliance requirements. Maintain employee records, joining documents, and statutory registers. Support compliance related to PF, ESIC, labour laws, and contractor workforce documentation. Coordinate onboarding and induction of site staff. Track employee leave records and attendance. Assist Head Office HR Team in implementing company policies and procedures. F. Guest House Management Manage project guest house operations and upkeep. Coordinate room bookings and visitor accommodations. Monitor housekeeping, maintenance, and utility services. Maintain inventory of guest house assets and consumables. Ensure smooth hospitality arrangements for management and visitors. G. MIS & Reporting Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports. Submit expenditure reports, procurement status reports, manpower reports, and inventory reports. Coordinate regularly with Head Office regarding project administration and accounts. Maintain document control and project records. Desired Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of accounting principles and office administration. Experience in construction project accounting and administration. Knowledge of labour law compliance, PF, ESIC, and contractor documentation. Experience in vendor management and procurement processes. Strong drafting skills for Purchase Orders, Work Orders, and vendor contracts. Excellent communication and coordination skills. Ability to work independently at project site locations. Good negotiation and vendor handling capabilities. High level of integrity and attention to detail. Software Skills Tally Prime MS Excel (Advanced) MS Word MS Outlook ERP Systems (preferred) Google Workspace Educational Qualification B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) / Equivalent Additional qualification in HR, Administration, or Supply Chain will be an advantage. Experience Minimum: 5 Years Preferred: 510 Years in Construction, Infrastructure, Industrial, or Real Estate Projects. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Accuracy of accounting and expense records. Timely processing of vendor bills and payments. Procurement turnaround time. Store inventory accuracy. Compliance with labour and statutory requirements. Timely MIS reporting to Head Office. Efficient management of office and guest house operations. Vendor and stakeholder satisfaction.

Complete ledger scrutiny and reconciliation. 
Maintain accurate accounting entries in Tally / ERP.

GST Notice

Ensure all statutory due dates are complied with.

 The candidate will be responsible for: 
 Project-wise billing and invoice tracking. 
Monitoring bills submitted to government clients. 
 Tracking outstanding payments and ageing. 
Coordinating with project, sales and management teams for collections. 
 Maintaining records of deductions, retention amounts, security deposits and taxes. 
 Tracking EMD, Security Deposit, Performance Guarantee and Bank Guarantee wherever applicable. 
Ensuring proper accounting of work orders, agreements and client payments.

Prepare ageing analysis of receivables. 
 Track long-pending government payments. 
Follow up internally with Sales / Project teams for collection status. 
Provide weekly collection MIS to management.

Verify vendor bills and supporting documents. 
Process payments as per approvals. 
Maintain vendor-wise ledger and reconciliation. 
Track outstanding vendor liabilities. 
Ensure correct TDS/GST treatment of vendor payments. 
Manage consultant, freelancer and service-provider payments. 
 6. Project-wise Accounting & Profitability 
 ORNET operates multiple projects simultaneously across different cities and states. 
 The Accounts Manager should: 
 Maintain project-wise income and expense records. 
 Track project budgets versus actual expenses. 
 Monitor manpower, travel, stay, vendor and operational expenses. 
 Prepare project-wise profitability reports. 
 Identify cost overruns and immediately highlight them to management.

Vendor and freelancer payments.

title: Senior Active Directory & Windows Administrator
description:
About Position: 
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Active Directory & Windows Administrator to manage and support enterprise Windows Server and Active Directory environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Active Directory administration, Windows Server management, virtualization technologies, infrastructure security, patch management, and Nutanix platforms. This role requires a proactive professional who can ensure high availability, performance, security, and operational excellence across critical infrastructure environments. 
 Role: Senior Active Directory Administrator Location: Pune, Noida Experience: 8 to 10 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Manage Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), domain controllers, forests, trusts, and identity services across the enterprise environment. Administer user accounts, security groups, organizational units (OUs), and role-based access controls. Design, implement, and maintain Group Policy Objects (GPOs) to enforce security and operational standards. Manage identity and access management processes, including authentication, authorization, and directory services. Install, configure, administer, and maintain Windows Server environments including Windows Server 2012, 2016, 2019, and 2022. Administer core infrastructure services such as DNS, DHCP, File Servers, Print Services, and related server roles. Monitor server performance and perform proactive optimization to ensure system stability and efficiency. Handle server provisioning, upgrades, migrations, decommissioning, and lifecycle management activities. Administer and support Nutanix clusters across production and non-production environments. Manage Nutanix Prism Central and Prism Element for infrastructure monitoring and administration. Monitor cluster health, capacity, resource utilization, and overall infrastructure performance. Configure and manage storage containers, protection domains, virtual machines, and disaster recovery components. Perform cluster upgrades, expansions, patching, and lifecycle management activities. Manage virtualization environments using VMware and Nutanix AHV platforms. Create, configure, maintain, and optimize virtual machines and virtualization resources. Perform VM migrations, snapshots, cloning, template management, and resource allocation activities. Plan and deploy operating system patching using WSUS, SCCM, or equivalent enterprise patch management tools.
