description:
This role will be responsible for establishing and strengthening the organization's internal audit, internal financial controls (IFC), risk management, and governance frameworks. It will provide independent assurance on the effectiveness of internal controls, risk mitigation measures, and compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements. Working closely with business leaders, the incumbent will identify control gaps, recommend process improvements, monitor implementation of corrective actions, and enhance the overall control environment. 
 Internal Audit Strategy & Assurance Develop and implement the annual risk-based internal audit plan, ensuring comprehensive coverage of financial, operational, compliance, and strategic risks. Ensure timely execution of audit engagements through internal and external audit partners in line with the approved audit calendar. Oversee the quality and effectiveness of audit reviews and ensure timely issuance of audit reports with actionable recommendations. Strengthen the internal audit framework to meet statutory requirements and support effective governance. 
 Internal Controls & Governance Design, implement, and continuously enhance the organization's Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and operational control framework. Establish and maintain comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), control matrices, and governance frameworks across business functions. Periodically assess the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls and recommend improvements to strengthen the control environment. Review and update internal control policies in line with business requirements, regulatory changes, and industry best practices. 
 Risk Management & Control Assurance Identify control gaps, process inefficiencies, and operational risks, and drive implementation of corrective and preventive actions by co-creating solutions with business units. Build a robust control assurance framework by partnering with functional teams to embed risk ownership and accountability. Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of audit recommendations and report the status of corrective actions. Lead the organization's fraud risk management framework, including fraud prevention, detection, investigation, and monitoring mechanisms . 
 Regulatory Compliance & Corporate Governance Assess the effectiveness of the organization's regulatory compliance framework and recommend improvements where required. Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) requirements, and other applicable regulatory and governance standards. Support statutory, internal, and regulatory audits by providing relevant documentation, insights, and assurance regarding the effectiveness of internal controls. Promote a culture of ethics, compliance, and accountability across the organization. 
 Reporting & Stakeholder Management Prepare and present periodic audit and risk reports, including key observations, risk assessments, and remediation status, to the CFO and CEO. Provide independent assurance to senior management and the Audit Committee on the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control processes. Engage with business leaders to provide advisory support on governance, process improvements, and risk mitigation initiatives. Liaise with external auditors, statutory auditors, and regulatory authorities on audit and compliance matters. 
 Continuous Improvement, Transformation & Innovation Drive continuous improvement initiatives by strengthening governance, simplifying processes, and enhancing the organization's control environment through standardized and efficient practices. Lead the adoption of digital transformation, automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to improve audit effectiveness, risk identification, control monitoring, and decision-making. Benchmark governance, risk management, and internal audit practices against industry best practices and implement innovative solutions to enhance organizational effectiveness and control maturity. Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and technology-enabled assurance by promoting the use of emerging technologies to proactively address business risks, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic objectives.

Strong exposure to enterprise risk management, internal controls, process audits, fraud risk management, and corporate governance. Should have team-handling experience with CAs. Proven experience in presenting audit findings and risk assessments to senior leadership. title: General Manager Operations
description:
Position Summary The General Manager Operations is a corporate leadership role responsible for driving operational strategy, excellence, and scale across KITES Senior Cares multi-city operations. The GM –Operations leads the Regional Managers and Centre Heads to ensure seamless execution, high-quality care delivery, and alignment to the organization’s mission and growth ambitions. The incumbent provides strategic guidance, leads cross-functional collaboration, and ensures a high-performing, values-driven operational ecosystem. The GM – Operations also acts as the key custodian of care standards, resident experience, financial performance, and people leadership across the organization. Reporting Lines In this position of GM – Operations, you will report to the Co-Founder, Director & Group COO or an executive nominated by the Management. The Company reserves the right to revise your reporting structure and responsibilities as required. Key Interactions Internal 
 • Regional Managers
 • Centre Heads
 • Clinical Heads
 • Corporate Teams – HR, Finance, Projects, Quality, IT External 
 • Healthcare Networks and Hospitals
 • Vendors and Service Providers
 • Statutory and Regulatory Bodies
 • Partners, Investors, and Industry Stakeholders
 • Residents and Families (as needed for escalations or strategy input) Core Responsibilities 1. Strategic Leadership & Planning Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with business goals and expansion plans.
 • Drive long-term planning and scenario building for regional and national operations.
 • Oversee capacity planning, new market entry, and service diversification.
 • Lead enterprise-level alignment across functions to embed performance culture and operational agility. 2. Oversight of Regional & Centre Operations Direct and support Regional Managers in overseeing city-wise operations and KPIs.
 • Ensure seamless functioning across facilities, homecare, and support services.
 • Set operational governance standards—dashboards, MIS, performance reviews, and escalation frameworks.
 • Drive execution excellence and hold Regional Managers accountable for compliance and outcomes. 3. Quality, Compliance & Resident Experience Ensure adherence to care quality standards (e.g., NABH), safety protocols, and operational SOPs.
 • Champion voice of customer through structured feedback, grievance redressal, and NPS reviews.
 • Drive a service excellence culture that balances clinical outcomes with empathetic care.
 • Institutionalize organization-wide audits, quality metrics, and incident tracking systems. 4. Financial & Resource Management Own and drive operational P&L for the vertical, with focus on cost efficiency and growth margins.
 • Lead annual budgeting, variance analysis, and financial monitoring with the Finance team.
 • Oversee shared services, central procurement, vendor contracts, and infrastructure utilization. 5. People Leadership & Capability Building Lead and mentor Regional Managers and key corporate operations team members.
 • Design and execute leadership development, performance management, and succession planning frameworks.
 • Build a culture of ownership, empowerment, and outcome-driven performance across units.
 • Drive talent engagement, especially at frontline and managerial levels in facilities and homecare. 6. Process Excellence & Technology Integration Drive operational transformation initiatives—Lean, Six Sigma, automation, workflow redesign.
 • Lead adoption of technology platforms (CRM, EHR, HRMS, ERP) to enhance decision-making and efficiency.
 • Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning. 7. External Relations & Ecosystem Engagement Represent the organization in industry bodies, regulatory forums, and healthcare alliances.
 • Build and sustain relationships with external stakeholders—government, partners, referral networks.
 • Ensure timely compliance with licensing, legal, and accreditation requirements across units.
 • Support investor presentations and updates with operational insights and dashboards. Work Complexities Multi-city oversight with diverse service lines and formats (residential, transitional, homecare).
 • High dependency on clinical and non-clinical coordination.
 • Need to balance profitability, regulatory compliance, and service empathy.
 • Requires agility in scaling operations while preserving personalized care experience. 
 Profile Knowledge and Experience MBA or Master’s in Healthcare Management, Operations or related field
 • 15+ years of experience with at least 5 years in leadership roles across multi-unit operations
 • Background in healthcare, hospitality, eldercare, or service-intensive sectors preferred
 • Strong business acumen, analytical mindset, and stakeholder management skills
 • Hands-on experience in scaling operations, setting up new locations, and managing change Competencies Strategic thinker with operational depth
 • Inclusive and values-driven leadership style
 • Excellent interpersonal, coaching, and communication skills
 • Strong data orientation with ability to drive performance via metrics
 • Empathetic, ethical, and passionate about elder care
 • Resilient and comfortable with ambiguity and rapid scale

title: Recruitment Team Lead - Non-IT Recruitment
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Recruitment Team Lead - Non-IT Recruitment to lead our recruitment team and manage end-to-end hiring for BPO, BFSI, Sales, Customer Support, Operations, Back Office, Field Operations, and other non-IT roles. The role will be responsible for team management, recruitment strategy, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, onboarding, recruitment MIS, and achieving hiring targets. The candidate should have strong hands-on recruitment experience and the ability to drive a team in a target-oriented environment. 
 Responsibilities 
 Recruitment Team Management - Lead and manage a team of recruiters. Allocate recruitment requirements and monitor individual recruiter performance. Set daily, weekly, and monthly hiring targets. Conduct regular team reviews and performance discussions. Coach recruiters on sourcing, screening, follow-ups, and closures. Track productivity, conversion ratios, and recruiter-wise performance. End-to-End Recruitment - Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requirement understanding to candidate onboarding. Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, databases, walk-ins, job fairs, and other channels. Screen candidates based on experience, skills, salary expectations, location, notice period, and role suitability. Coordinate interviews with HR and Operations teams. Manage offer discussions, documentation, joining follow-ups, and onboarding. Non-IT Hiring - Handle recruitment for roles such as: BPO / Call Centre Executives, Customer Support / Voice Non-Voice, Team Leaders / Operations Managers, Sales Business Development, Back Office / Data Entry, Field Operations, Finance Accounts, HR Administration, ATM / Banking Operations, Other business and support functions. Recruitment Planning Strategy - Understand manpower requirements from Operations and business teams. Develop sourcing plans based on volume, location, skill requirements, and joining timelines. Identify new recruitment channels to improve candidate availability. Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline. Plan bulk hiring drives and walk-in recruitment campaigns where required. Stakeholder Management - Work closely with Operations, HR, and business managers to understand hiring requirements. Ensure clear communication on open positions, candidate status, interview feedback, and joining plans. Escalate recruitment challenges and recommend corrective actions. Maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders. Recruitment MIS Reporting - Prepare and maintain daily/weekly/monthly recruitment reports covering: Open positions; Profiles sourced; Profiles screened; Profiles shortlisted; Interviews scheduled; Interviews completed; Offers released; Offers accepted; Candidates joined; Offer-to-join ratio; Source-wise hiring; Recruiter-wise productivity; Pending requirements; Attrition / early dropouts. Candidate Experience Joining Management - Ensure timely communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Minimize candidate dropouts between selection and joining. Conduct regular follow-ups with selected candidates. Identify reasons for offer declines and no-shows. Maintain a positive candidate experience. Key Performance Indicators 
 Monthly hiring target achievement Requirement closure TAT Recruiter productivity Interview-to-selection ratio Offer-to-joining ratio Joining conversion Quality of hire Recruitment source effectiveness Candidate dropout percentage Recruiter team performance Stakeholder satisfaction Qualifications Experience 
 Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage. 3-5 years of recruitment experience, preferably with experience in Non-IT/BPO/ITES hiring. Minimum 1-2 years of experience managing a recruitment team preferred. Experience handling bulk hiring and multiple locations will be an advantage. Experience with recruitment platforms such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Apna, WorkIndia, and other sourcing channels will be preferred. Preferred Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate should be someone who can personally drive recruitment closures while effectively managing a team. Strong ownership, follow-up discipline, data-driven recruitment management, and the ability to work under hiring targets are essential.

title: Assistant Manager-IT Ops
description:
Role & responsibilities Job Role The Assistant Manager - IT Security Operations will be responsible for the day-to-day management, implementation, monitoring, and optimization of the organization's endpoint and IT security controls. The role will have a strong technical focus on EDR/XDR, endpoint protection, vulnerability and patch management, security hardening, incident response, security tools, and implementation of cybersecurity controls across the IT environment . The individual will work closely with IT Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, Engineering, Application, IAM, GRC, and other stakeholders to identify security gaps, implement remediation measures, respond to security incidents, and continuously improve the organization's security posture. Experience Experience: 69 years in IT Security / Cybersecurity / Security Operations, with strong hands-on experience in endpoint and security technologies. Key Technical Responsibilities 1. EDR / XDR Operations & Management Own the day-to-day administration, monitoring, and operational management of EDR/XDR platforms across enterprise endpoints and servers. Manage EDR/XDR deployment, agent health, policy configuration, exclusions, prevention controls, detection rules, and security profiles. Monitor endpoint security posture and ensure adequate EDR/XDR coverage across Windows, macOS, Linux, and other supported platforms. Investigate and respond to endpoint alerts, suspicious activities, malware detections, behavioral detections, and security incidents. Perform detailed analysis of endpoint telemetry including processes, command lines, network connections, file activities, registry changes, persistence mechanisms, and user activity. Develop and maintain EDR/XDR detection and prevention policies based on emerging threats and organizational requirements. Tune EDR/XDR policies and detection rules to minimize false positives while maintaining appropriate security coverage. Coordinate with vendors for complex incidents, product issues, detection gaps, and technical escalations. Track EDR/XDR agent health, outdated agents, inactive devices, policy mismatches, and deployment failures. Prepare operational dashboards and reports covering EDR coverage, detections, incidents, agent health, and remediation status. Evaluate and implement advanced EDR/XDR capabilities such as behavioral protection, application control, exploit prevention, ransomware protection, attack surface reduction, and threat hunting. 2. Endpoint Security Implement and maintain endpoint security controls across corporate devices and servers. Define and enforce endpoint security baselines and hardening standards. Manage Antivirus/NGAV, EDR/XDR, host firewall, device control, application control, encryption, and endpoint protection policies. Identify gaps in endpoint security configurations and drive remediation with relevant IT teams. Support secure device provisioning, endpoint onboarding, security configuration, and decommissioning. Investigate endpoint-related security events and perform root-cause analysis. 3. Vulnerability & Patch Management Own and coordinate the organization's vulnerability and patch management lifecycle . Identify vulnerabilities across endpoints, servers, applications, and infrastructure using vulnerability management tools. Analyze vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, business impact, asset criticality, and exposure. Define patching priorities and remediation timelines based on organizational risk. Coordinate with IT Infrastructure, Desktop Engineering, Server, Application, and Cloud teams for timely remediation. Track critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities through closure. Manage patch deployment activities, patch compliance, exceptions, and remediation validation. Develop dashboards and management reports covering patch compliance, vulnerability aging, critical vulnerabilities, and remediation status. Investigate failed patches and coordinate corrective actions. Establish patch compliance targets and continuously improve endpoint/server patching processes. Support emergency patching activities for actively exploited or zero-day vulnerabilities. 4. Security Incident Response Participate in and lead technical response to cybersecurity incidents involving endpoints, servers, applications, and infrastructure. Perform initial triage, investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery activities. Analyze EDR/XDR telemetry to identify attack vectors, affected assets, indicators of compromise, lateral movement, and persistence. Coordinate endpoint isolation, malicious file remediation, account containment, process termination, and other response actions as required. This role will serve as the subject matter expert for venue and event sourcing, providing commercial guidance and market intelligence to stakeholders while driving value, compliance, cost optimisation and service excellence. The successful candidate will possess strong hospitality industry knowledge, a deep understanding of hotel operations and contracting terminology, and the ability to negotiate complex event agreements across multiple markets. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, procurement teams, meeting planners and suppliers to deliver sourcing solutions that align with EY's Meetings & Events strategy and policies.   Key Responsibilities Strategic Venue & Supplier Sourcing Lead venue sourcing activities for meetings, conferences, leadership events, training programmes, offsites and client-facing events. Analyse event requirements and develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives, budget and attendee experience expectations. Source and evaluate hotels, convention centres, resorts, event venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies and other event suppliers. Conduct market research and benchmark venue rates, supplier capabilities and industry trends to support decision-making. Provide venue recommendations based on location suitability, contractual terms, operational feasibility, attendee experience and commercial value. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead RFP, RFQ and proposal evaluation processes for hotels, venues and event suppliers. Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, concessions and contractual protections to maximise value and mitigate risk. Ensure all supplier agreements comply with EY procurement policies, legal requirements and standard contract templates. Drive savings initiatives through strategic sourcing, preferred supplier utilisation and volume-based negotiations. Support supplier renewals and contract reviews while maintaining a strong supplier governance framework. Hospitality & Industry Expertise Serve as the M&E team's subject matter expert on hotel operations, venue management and hospitality contracting. Demonstrate strong knowledge of hotel industry terminology including: Guest room blocks and pickup analysis Attrition and cancellation clauses Food & Beverage minimum commitments Meeting room rental structures Complimentary ratios and concession strategies Revenue displacement and peak period pricing Force majeure and risk mitigation clauses Commission and non-commission models, and negotiated rate structures Advise stakeholders on hotel operational considerations that impact cost, attendee experience and event success. Maintain knowledge of regional and global hospitality market trends, supplier capabilities and emerging venue solutions. Stakeholder Management Partner with meeting sponsors, event planners and business stakeholders to understand sourcing requirements and event objectives. Provide sourcing guidance and recommendations throughout the meeting and event lifecycle. Act as the primary escalation point for venue and supplier-related issues during sourcing and contracting phases. Build strong relationships with key hotel brands, venue operators, event agencies and industry partners. Supplier Performance & Governance Monitor supplier performance against contractual service levels and programme expectations. Support supplier onboarding, due diligence and ongoing relationship management activities. Maintain sourcing databases, preferred supplier catalogues and venue intelligence resources. Identify opportunities to enhance supplier performance, improve service delivery and strengthen strategic partnerships. Reporting & Process Improvement Analyse sourcing activity, contract performance and savings opportunities through reporting and KPI management. Support compliance monitoring and programme governance initiatives across the M&E function. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline sourcing processes, improve stakeholder experience and enhance programme efficiencies. Own and drive data entry and accuracy on CVENT and contract uploads on ARIBA Support sourcing-related technology platforms, databases and supplier management tools.   Education Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Tourism, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related field preferred. Hospitality or procurement-related professional certifications are advantageous.   Experience Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in hotel sales, venue sourcing, hospitality procurement, destination management, corporate event management or strategic sourcing. Strong experience negotiating hotel contracts and managing large-scale venue sourcing projects. Experience working with global hotel chains, event agencies and hospitality suppliers. Demonstrated knowledge of meetings and events operations and procurement practices. Experience working in multinational, matrixed and stakeholder-driven environments is highly desirable.   Skills & Competencies Strong expertise in hotel, venue and event supplier sourcing, with a deep understanding of hospitality operations and industry terminology. Proven contract negotiation, supplier management and procurement experience with a strong commercial mindset. Ability to drive cost optimisation, budget management and data-driven sourcing decisions. title: Quality Management System Manager
description:
Job Description: QMS Manager

Company: Sharpwire
Position: Quality Management System (QMS) Manager
Experience: Minimum 5 years
Industry: Automotive / Manufacturing

Position Summary

Sharpwire is looking for an experienced QMS Manager to lead and strengthen our Quality Management System, ensure compliance with ISO 9001 & IATF 16949 requirements, and drive continuous improvement across manufacturing and quality processes.

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience, with strong exposure to internal audits, customer audits, certification audits, corrective actions, defect reduction, and quality performance monitoring.

Key Responsibilities

QMS & IATF 16949

   Lead and maintain the companys IATF 16949 Quality Management System.
   Keep ISO documents updated and ensure ISO compliance.
¢   Ensure compliance with applicable customer-specific requirements and quality standards.
¢   Plan and conduct internal QMS and process audits.
¢   Lead preparation for IATF, customer, and certification-body audits.
¢   Ensure timely closure and effectiveness verification of audit findings and non-conformities.
¢   Maintain QMS documentation, procedures, work instructions, records, and quality objectives.

Defect Reduction & Quality Improvement

¢   Drive initiatives to reduce internal and external defects, rejection, rework, scrap, and customer complaints.
¢   Monitor quality KPIs and identify areas requiring immediate corrective or preventive action.
¢   Lead Root Cause Analysis, 8D, CAPA, 5-Why, Fishbone, and other problem-solving activities.
¢   Establish and monitor defect-reduction targets for production and supporting functions.
¢   Work closely with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and Supply Chain teams to eliminate recurring quality issues.

Quality Trend Analysis

¢   Track quality defects and trends by product, process, machine, shift, customer, supplier, and defect type.
¢   Develop and maintain Pareto analysis, trend charts, rejection reports, and quality dashboards.
¢   Identify recurring and emerging quality trends and initiate preventive actions before issues become major problems.
¢   Present quality performance, trends, risks, and improvement actions to management.
¢   Use data-driven analysis to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and defect prevention.

Customer Quality

¢   Monitor and manage customer complaints and quality concerns.
¢   Ensure effective and timely response to customer complaints, including 8D reports and corrective actions.
¢   Track customer PPM, complaints, returns, and other customer quality indicators.
¢   Work with relevant teams to prevent recurrence of customer issues.

Continuous Improvement

¢   Drive PDCA and continual improvement activities throughout the organization.
¢   Establish quality improvement projects focused on defect reduction, process capability, and customer satisfaction.
¢   Promote a strong zero-defect and prevention-oriented quality culture.
¢   Monitor the effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

¢   Lead and develop the Quality team.
¢   Train employees on QMS requirements, quality procedures, problem-solving, and audit readiness.
¢   Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues.
¢   Ensure accountability for quality objectives and improvement actions across departments.

Required Qualifications & Experience

¢   Bachelors degree/Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, Quality, or related field.
¢   Minimum 5 years of hands-on IATF 16949 audit experience.
¢   Strong experience in IATF 16949 QMS implementation, maintenance, and auditing.
¢   Experience handling IATF certification audits, customer audits, and internal audits.
¢   Strong knowledge of:
 * IATF 16949
 * ISO 9001
 * Core Tools APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA, SPC
 * 8D / CAPA / Root Cause Analysis
 * Process and Product Auditing
 * Control Plans
 * Statistical and trend analysis
¢   Proven track record of reducing defects, rejection, scrap, rework, and customer complaints.
¢   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
¢   Good communication and leadership skills.
¢   Proficiency in Excel and quality data analysis/reporting.

Preferred

¢   Automotive manufacturing experience.
¢   Experience with wire, cable, harness, metal forming, stamping, or related manufacturing processes.
¢   Certified IATF 16949 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor.
¢   Experience with customer-specific requirements and major automotive customer audits.
¢   Experience implementing measurable quality improvement projects.


Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the ability to maintain a robust IATF 16949 QMS, achieve strong audit performance, identify quality trends early, eliminate recurring defects, reduce overall rejection and customer complaints, and establish a culture of prevention and continuous improvement at Sharpwire.

title: Product Innovation and Design Manager
description:
Department: Product & Design 
 Industry: Information & Technology, preferably Logistics & Freight 
 Location: Pune / Remote 
 Experience Range: 6+ years of combined Product Management and UX/Design experience; at least 3 years hands-on in Figma and design prototyping; 2+ years Product Management or managing product design team 
 Basic Qualification: BE/B-TECH/MCA/BCA or bachelor's degree in a related subject; formal design qualification (HCI, Interaction Design, Visual Design) strongly preferred 
 Travel Requirements: No 
 Website: www.quloi.com 
 Our mission Our mission is to Quantifying all activities for logistics stakeholders. 
 Our Vision Our vision is to Enable businesses to make the best logistics decisions. 
 Whats the Role? We are looking for a Product Innovation and Design Manager who is equally at home defining a new product concept and opening Figma to prototype it themselves. This is a senior role that combines: the strategic product thinking to identify and incubate new solutions, the hands-on design craft to bring those concepts to life using Figma and AI-powered prototyping tools such as Claude Design, and the management experience to lead and grow Qulois UX team. You will own the full arc from discovery to validated prototype — running user research, shaping product direction, designing and iterating in Figma, and leveraging Claude Design to accelerate high-fidelity prototyping before a single line of production code is written. Once a new module or solution is validated, you need to follow the Product basics and prepare the BRD, PRD and make sure the solution is documented properly. 
 Responsibilities/ Duties 1. Lead New Feature Discovery and Incubation: Identify opportunities for entirely new product modules/features by monitoring industry trends, competitor products, regulatory developments, and evolving logistics standards. Define proof-of-concept criteria and validate new concepts with pilot customers before committing engineering resources to full development. Maintain an innovation backlog — a prioritised pipeline of ideas at different validation stages — reviewed regularly with the Head of Product and leadership. Own the structured Product process from validated new modules to ensuring design assets, and product requirements are fully documented. 2. Design and Prototype Hands-On in Figma and Claude Design: Create wireframes, interaction flows, and high-fidelity UI designs directly in Figma for all new product initiatives and innovation concepts. Use Claude Design to rapidly generate and iterate on prototypes, accelerating the design-to-validation cycle and exploring a broader solution space before committing to a direction. Build and maintain a shared Figma component library and design system that all product surfaces — core and local versions — draw from, ensuring visual and interaction consistency across the platform. Produce handoff-ready design specifications, annotated prototypes, and developer notes that engineering teams can implement without ambiguity. 3. Lead and Develop the UX Team: Manage and mentor the UX team (UX researchers, interaction designers, UI designers), setting clear goals, development plans, and quality standards. Own the UX team roadmap and ensure design capacity is allocated across innovation initiatives, core product enhancements, and local version requirements — coordinated through the AI PM Orchestrator. Conduct structured design reviews and hold a consistently high bar for usability, accessibility, and visual quality across all Quloi product surfaces. Actively develop team members’ skills in AI-assisted design tooling, including Claude Design, as part of the team’s ongoing capability uplift. 4. Drive UX Research for New Solutions: Plan and lead UX research activities (user interviews, usability testing, journey mapping, contextual inquiry) to validate new module concepts at every stage. Synthesise research findings into clear product requirements, design briefs, and prioritised problem statements that both the UX team and engineering can act on. Ensure user insight drives every design decision — from initial concept sketch to final prototype — rather than being a one-time input at the start of discovery. 5. Collaborate Across the PM Organisation: Work with the VP of Product to ensure new modules are architecturally and visually compatible with the existing platform — building on the existing product database rather than rebuilding from scratch. Brief Local Version PMs on new modules entering the pipeline early enough for regional design requirements to be incorporated in the initial Figma files. Participate in cross-PM syncs and AI PM Orchestrator-led workflows covering documentation, Confluence pages, and Jira ticket hygiene. 6. Measure Innovation and Design Impact: Define success metrics at the proof-of-concept stage for each new module (e.g., pilot adoption rate, task completion in usability tests, stakeholder confidence score, prototype-to-build time saved via Claude Design). Track UX team performance including design delivery cycle time, usability test scores, design system adoption rate, and cross-team satisfaction. Report innovation pipeline status, prototype velocity, and UX team throughput to leadership on a regular cadence. 
 Criteria for the Role! Experience: 6+ years of combined Product Management and UX/Design experience. Candidates with only a PM background and no hands-on design craft, or only a design background with no PM experience, will not be considered. Figma Proficiency: Advanced Figma skills are non-negotiable — you must be able to independently produce wireframes, high-fidelity UI designs, interactive prototypes, and a structured component library to a professional standard. Claude Design Experience: Demonstrated experience using Claude Design or equivalent AI-powered prototyping tools to generate, iterate on, and validate product concepts. Ability to brief, prompt, and critically evaluate AI-generated design output. UX Team Management: Minimum 2 years of formal people management responsibility for a UX or product design team, including goal-setting, performance development, and capacity planning. 0-to-1 Product Experience: Proven track record of taking a new product concept from initial idea to validated proof-of-concept in a B2B SaaS environment. Portfolio evidence is required. UX Research Fluency: Hands-on experience planning and conducting user research (not just commissioning it). You know when to run a usability test versus a user interview, and can do both yourself when needed. Design Systems: Experience building and governing a shared component library or design system used by multiple teams or product surfaces. Industry Domain knowledge is a strong advantage: Strong interest in logistics, supply chain, or trade technology; able to understand an industry standard or regulatory document and translate it into a product and design implication. Platform Awareness: Understands multi-tenant SaaS platform architecture at a conceptual level; designs with component reuse, localisation, and scalability in mind from the first wireframe. Communication: Able to present early-stage, ambiguous concepts confidently to senior stakeholders and translate feedback into actionable design and product decisions. Tooling: Figma (advanced), Claude Design, Jira, Confluence. Familiarity with handoff tools (Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin) and user testing platforms (Maze, UserTesting, Lookback) is an advantage.

Key Skills: Ui/Ux,JIRA,Figma,Project Management,Rice,Product Strategy,Sprint Planning,Product Roadmap

JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Senior Manager - Payroll 

 About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Manager -payroll to lead end-to-end payroll operations, 
 statutory compliance, payroll governance and related HR operations. 
 The role will ensure accurate, timely, compliant and efficient payroll processing while partnering with HR, Finance, 
 Business Heads and external payroll/statutory partners. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Payroll Management 
 Own the complete monthly payroll cycle. 
 Ensure accurate processing of salary, incentives, deductions, reimbursements, arrears and bonuses. 
 Review attendance, leave, joiner, exit, salary revision, promotion and transfer inputs. 
 Conduct payroll validation and reconciliation before closure. 
 Ensure timely salary disbursement and resolution of payroll queries. 
 2. Statutory Compliance 
Ensure compliance relating to PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, Bonus, Gratuity and other applicable requirements. 
 Monitor changes in labour laws and payroll regulations. 
 Support implementation of applicable Labour Codes. 
 Coordinate with consultants, auditors and statutory authorities. 
 3. Payroll Governance & Controls 
 Establish payroll controls and approval mechanisms. 
 Identify payroll risks and control gaps and implement corrective actions. 
 Momentum Pvt. Ltd. | Senior Manager Payroll 
 Conduct periodic payroll audits and reconciliations. 
 Maintain payroll SOPs, documentation and compliance calendars. 
 4. HRMS & Payroll Systems 
 Manage payroll-related HRMS processes and employee master data. 
 Coordinate with HRMS/payroll vendors for enhancements and issue resolution. 
 Drive payroll automation and process improvements. 
 Ensure data accuracy, confidentiality and appropriate system access. 
 5. Employee Lifecycle Management 
 Integrate payroll with joining, confirmation, transfers, promotions, salary revisions, leave, attendance and exits. 
 Ensure accurate and timely Full & Final Settlements. 
 Manage leave encashment, gratuity, notice pay and other settlement components. 
 6. MIS & Analytics 
 Prepare monthly payroll MIS and management reports. 
 Conduct payroll cost and variance analysis. 
 Support employee-cost budgeting and forecasting. 
 Provide payroll analytics and insights to senior management. 
 7. Team & Stakeholder Management 
 Lead and develop the payroll and compliance team. 
 Work closely with HR, Finance, Accounts and business stakeholders. 
 Manage external payroll vendors and consultants.

title: Warehouse Manager
description:
Job Description Warehouse Manager 
 
 
 Designation: Warehouse Manager 
 Function: Supply Chain / Warehouse & Logistics 
 Location: Gurgaon 
 Experience: 48 Years 
 Reporting To: Senior Manager 
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 
 About the Role 
 
 
 We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager to manage end-to-end warehouse and logistics operations, ensuring efficient inbound and outbound movement, inventory accuracy, order fulfillment, transportation management, and adherence to safety and compliance standards. The role will be responsible for managing warehouse operations across GT (General Trade) and D2C channels , driving operational efficiency, optimizing costs, and ensuring timely order fulfillment and delivery. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 1. Warehouse Operations 
 
 
 Manage end-to-end inbound and outbound warehouse operations , including receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, and order fulfillment. Ensure smooth and timely fulfillment of orders across GT and D2C channels . Optimize warehouse space utilization, storage practices, and material movement. Ensure adherence to defined SOPs and operational processes. Monitor warehouse productivity and identify opportunities for process improvement. 
 
 2. Logistics & Transportation 
 
 
 Manage fleet and transportation operations to ensure timely and cost-effective deliveries. Plan and optimize delivery routes based on shipment volumes and destinations. Coordinate with transporters and logistics partners for daily operations. Negotiate with transport vendors and monitor transportation costs. Track and improve On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance. Resolve transportation-related issues and delivery exceptions. 
 
 3. Inventory Management 
 
 
 Monitor inventory levels and ensure optimum stock availability. Raise daily indents in DDMRP as per inventory requirements. Ensure accurate inventory records and minimize stock discrepancies. Conduct regular cycle counts and physical inventory checks . Investigate inventory variances and implement corrective actions. Drive inventory accuracy and ensure proper stock rotation and storage. 
 
 4. Team Leadership & People Management 
 
 
 Lead, supervise, and manage warehouse and logistics teams. Allocate manpower and prepare daily/shift-wise work schedules. Train team members on warehouse processes, SOPs, safety, and systems. Set productivity targets and monitor individual/team performance. Build a culture of accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement. 
 
 5. Safety & Compliance 
 
 
 Ensure strict adherence to workplace safety standards and warehouse safety procedures. Conduct regular safety checks and ensure corrective actions are implemented. Ensure compliance with applicable statutory and legal requirements. Maintain proper documentation, records, and audit readiness. Promote safe material handling and housekeeping practices within the warehouse. 
 
 6. Systems, MIS & Reporting 
 
 
 Monitor and report key warehouse and logistics KPIs . Ensure effective utilization of systems such as Uniware, SAP, TMS, BI , and other relevant warehouse/logistics tools. Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports. Track metrics such as Order Fulfillment, Inventory Accuracy, On-Time Dispatch, On-Time Delivery, Warehouse Productivity, Transportation Cost, Space Utilization, Order Processing TAT, and Inventory Variance. Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps and drive continuous improvement. 
 
 Key Skills & Competencies 
 
 
 Strong knowledge of warehouse and logistics operations Experience in GT and D2C order fulfillment Inventory management and cycle counting Transportation and fleet management Route planning and vendor management Team handling and people management Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Good understanding of warehouse KPIs and MIS Hands-on experience with Uniware / SAP / TMS / BI or similar systems Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Knowledge of warehouse safety and compliance requirements Process-oriented mindset with a focus on cost optimization and operational efficiency 
 
 Qualification & Experience 
 
 
 Graduate/Postgraduate in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Business Administration , or a related field. 48 years of relevant experience in warehouse, logistics, distribution, or supply chain operations. Prior experience managing warehouse teams and logistics operations will be preferred. Experience in D2C/e-commerce and General Trade distribution will be an added advantage. 
 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 
 
 Warehouse productivity and efficiency Inventory accuracy Order fulfillment and dispatch TAT On-Time Delivery (OTD) Transportation cost optimization Warehouse space utilization Inventory variance Team productivity Safety and compliance Process adherence and continuous improvement

title: Senior Manager Internal Audit & Risk Management
description:
Role & responsibilities 1. Internal Audit & Risk Management Risk Management Experience in identifying, assessing, and monitoring operational, financial, and compliance risks within assigned functions or departments. Support the implementation of risk mitigation strategies, controls, and standard operating procedures to minimize potential business impact. Ensure day-to-day activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and company guidelines. Escalate identified risks, incidents, or control gaps to the Manager or relevant stakeholders in a timely manner. Participate in internal audits, inspections, and risk assessments, and assist in preparing required documentation and reports. Monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) and support corrective and preventive actions where necessary. Promote risk awareness among team members by reinforcing best practices and compliance standards. Support business continuity and contingency planning activities as assigned. Audit Planning & Execution Hands on experience in Risk based audit planning, execution and reporting Review of business, operational and functional areas across Retail, real Estate and Manufacturing sector to identify risks, provide risk mitigation plans, work with business teams to implement the controls. Execute risk-based internal audits for retail stores, warehouses, distribution centres, and head office functions. Supervise retail operations audits covering cash handling, POS controls, inventory management, discounts, promotions, and shrinkage to reduce risks or theft or revenue leakage Inventory & Loss Prevention Controls Supervise cycle counts, stock verifications, and surprise audits at stores and warehouses. Analyze shrinkage, pilferage, expiries, damages, and slow-moving inventory, and provide recommendations to improve the controls and governance. Support business in implementing relevant loss prevention controls, CCTV usage, access controls, and store compliance. 2. Operational Audit & Compliance Review Perform Business and operational audits such as procurement-to-pay, order-to-cash, and inventory management, sales management (pricing, promotions, markdowns, and loyalty programs), Supply Chain and Logistics, etc. Ensure adherence to internal and operational efficiency while performing audit reviews. Review of compliance requirements such as tax, legal, and regulatory requirements, and support management relevant to FMCG, retail, Real Estate and Manufacturing sector to implement controls Ensure compliance with internal SOPs, delegation of authority, and retail policies. Evaluate IT and POS system controls, including user access and master data changes. Review & evaluate the adequacy of controls in new system implementation, projects or newly set up business units Review and supervise the accuracy of financial accounting, reconciliation processes, and statutory compliance activities. Verify adherence to IFRS/Ind AS and company accounting policies. Review and test internal financial controls (IFC) and report on operating effectiveness. Supervise the quality of out-sourced audit firms and ensure issues are closed to address the identified controls gaps. Monitor implementation of audit recommendations and highlight risk areas for management review. Design and implement an audit compliance /action tracking mechanism for mitigating identified risks in the audit reports. Provide update to Senior management about the open audit actions. Support management to implement the required controls to mitigate the risk via required SOPs, automated controls, governance, etc. 3. Data Analytics & Automation Use Excel, Power BI, or other analytical tools to identify anomalies, trends, and potential risk indicators. Support implementation of automated audit tests and dashboards for continuous monitoring. Assist in digitization of audit workpapers and development of data-driven audit methodologies. 4. Coordination & Reporting Collaborate with finance, operations, and compliance teams to ensure audit readiness and consistency in control practices. Prepare and submit audit reports, dashboards, and compliance updates to senior management - highlighting operational gaps, financial risks, and control weaknesses. Rate audit observations based on impact and likelihood. Follow up on corrective actions and validate implementation at stores and warehouses. 1. Stakeholders management Build and maintain strong working relationship with all internal and external stakeholders. Maintain regular follow-ups related to projects and task allotted with Head of Audit and senior management. Manage Audit and Assurance resources for the effective delivery of assigned tasks. Work closely with business and functional heads, Operations team, supply chain, IT, finance teams, etc. Support external audits and internal investigations, including fraud and revenue leakage cases. 2. Leadership & Development Foster a culture of professional scepticism, innovation, and ethical conduct within the team. Provide leadership to ongoing Audit and Assurance team for effective delivery and improve their ways of working 3. Self-Development Develop oneself through organizational initiatives like coaching, training, continuous feedback sessions and learn from interactions at the management level about the strategic intent desired by them. Champion a culture of integrity, compliance, and continuous improvement across the organization Dedicate time learning new methodologies for Risk, Compliance and digitisation to improve overall governance and effectiveness of controls and efficiency of operations. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Technical Hands on Experience in International audit techniques and Standards 
 Competencies Strong knowledge in the Internal and External audit domains including financials, operational, processes, risk assessment, compliance, etc. Internal Audit functioning, regulation and control in Procurement, Back Office operations, Food/Grocery/Pharma Retail sector, Real Estate, Manufacturing sector Knowledge of Reporting Tools like Power BI, Tableau, etc. for management reporting Experienced in audit of SAP ERP or other ERP systems like Axpert and procurement tools Knowledge of Accounting standards, Financial Reporting and Compliance requirements 

 Behavioural Analytical mindset and problem-solving skill 
 Competencies Must be self-directed and able to work independently. Ability to see the big picture with high attention to critical details Excellent consultative, interpersonal, communication and presentation skills. Good governance and control perspective Strong willed and able to influence Ability to champion continuous change and consult with versatility 
 Qualification CA, CPA or MBA Finance or equivalent education 
 Work Experience 10 years and above experience in internal audit, operational audit, risk management or compliance roles in large & multi location companies, preferably in Africa continent Proven experience in independently executing Internal Audits and Assurance work. Experience in managing Internal Audit and Assurance team and leading effective discussion with CEOs & senior management

title: Sr. Commercial Relationship Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facilities management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. We are committed to creating a great product for our customers and a great work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally. ServiceChannel is seeking a Senior Commercial Relationship Manager (Team Lead) to join our India Delivery Center (IDC) in Bangalore. This is a customer-facing, quota-bearing role that combines ownership of a portfolio of higher-value SMB / Small Commercial accounts with a player-coach responsibility to improve execution consistency across the IDC commercial team. The Senior RM partners closely with U.S.-based leadership to drive forecasting rigor, escalation handling, and operational excellence across the scaled coverage model. This role will support our Global customer base with primary account ownership across United States (majority) and Europe (minority). The roles will scale to align to U.S. and Europe business hours; working with customers across all U.S. and European time zones. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own and execute the end-to-end renewal and upsell process across an assigned portfolio, including proactive outreach, renewal planning, pricing execution, contract progression, and negotiations. Own expansion outcomes for the portfolio by identifying, qualifying, and executing upsell and cross-sell opportunities using structured commercial plays. Conduct customer-facing commercial conversations (renewals, pricing discussions, negotiations, and expansion conversations) with professionalism and strong business acumen. Act as a player-coach for the IDC commercial team: provide targeted deal support, coaching, and best-practice guidance on renewals and expansion execution. Serve as the first point of escalation for complex customer scenarios, commercial exceptions, or cross-functional blockers; coordinate resolution with Support, Billing / Collections, Implementation / Professional Services, Product, and U.S. Account Management leadership. Maintain high-quality account and opportunity data in Salesforce, Gainsight, and related tools to ensure forecasting accuracy, visibility, and continuity across teams. Ensure consistent execution of playbooks, standard work, and segmentation rules across the IDC team; identify bottlenecks and opportunities to improve cycle time and customer experience. Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to align commercial priorities with adoption and customer health signals; support (but do not own) EBR preparation and follow-up by providing commercial context and action plans. Partner with Sales Enablement and U.S. leadership to provide feedback on playbooks and enablement needs based on real-world execution. Participate in staggered-shift coverage aligned to U.S. and European time zones, including overlap into U.S. Pacific Time mornings (targeting availability through ~12:00 PM Pacific) to support live customer engagement and escalations. 
 
 Required Skills Experience 
 7+ years experience in a customer-facing commercial role (Account Management, Relationship Management, Renewals, Inside Sales, or Customer Success with commercial ownership), preferably in a SaaS environment. Demonstrated success owning complex renewals and negotiations and consistently delivering against quota. Proven ability to drive expansion outcomes (upsell / cross-sell) and to influence deal strategy. Exceptional spoken and written English communication skills and strong customer presence with U.S.-based customers. Demonstrated ability to coach peers and lead through influence (player-coach mindset) without formal people-management authority. Strong business management discipline: forecasting rigor, prioritization, and the ability to synthesize insights for leadership. Proficiency with CRM and customer systems (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight) and a track record of data hygiene and operational excellence. Ability to collaborate cross-functionally, remove blockers, and drive outcomes in a complex environment. 
 
 Preferred Skills Experience 
 Experience supporting scaled customer coverage models and/or working with offshore/distributed teams. Experience leading operational initiatives (process improvement, Kaizen, standard work) that improve commercial execution. Experience in Facility Management and/or relevant verticals (Retail, Restaurants, Grocery, etc.).
